scope: Original P1 helicopter ammunition and weapon-user profiles, decoded by engine reflection registration; static analysis, not original-engine execution.
sourceHost: WIN-20251114GJY at 192.168.1.6, strict existing SSH host key verified

decoding.endianness: Little endian META profile records. This differs from the ATEM GameObject payloads in mission TOD files.
decoding.strings: Named profile references use U8 byte count; accuracyGainTimer uses U32LE byte count. All names ASCII, booleans 0/1, floats finite, and all 110 payload end offsets checked exactly.

findings: AI helicopter cannon, Hellfire and rapid-missile WeaponUserProfile values have infiniteAmmo=true; corresponding player profiles have false. Player clip/capacity and AI resource policy must not be conflated.

AI heli_gunship_helifire_ammo (original spelling) has initialVelocity=0, acceleration=50, speed=60, TTL=10, distanceToLive=175, trackingDelay=0.5, tracking=true, perfectlyAccurateTracking=false, maxTurningVelocity=6, interpolation=true, inheritSpawnerVelocity=true, minDot=0.
Player Hellfire profiles have maxTurningVelocity=10 and minDot approximately -0.3; marine clip=4 and Blackwatch clip=5 before unlock additions.
Marine rapid missile is a separate unguided profile: initialVelocity=150, speed=125, fireRate=4, TTL=15, tracking=false, turning=0. It must not be presented as Hellfire.

The engine AmmoProfile registration contains 21 properties, including tracerParams at member offset 8. Decimal push operands initially hid this property; reader now handles both decimal and hexadecimal immediates.

Static call chain observed: Javelin update 0x10467660 -> missile update 0x1046c0c0 -> tracking 0x1046a0e0 -> shared turning helper 0x101265b0. Flight acceleration/sideways-friction helper is 0x10468430.
runtimeInferences: At 0x1046a1fc, missile age is compared with profile trackingDelay (+0xa4) before calling guidance.

At 0x1046a4ee, maxTurningVelocity (+0x7c) is supplied to shared guidance. At 0x10126848..0x10126878 the interpolation branch scales the limit by current speed/profile speed, dt, and the turn parameter, and caps it to the current angle. Exact math helper semantics and initialization remain to be validated before implementing the full trajectory.

At 0x10468430 velocity is split into heading-parallel and sideways components; 0x1046858a..0x1046859e increases sideways-friction state from airFrictionIncreaseRate. A simple constant-speed rotate-towards implementation would omit this state.
implementedNow: AI uses infinite firing resources independently of finite manual player stores; accepted gun/rocket shot counters persist and drive AI pod alternation. Existing firing permissions, cooldowns, four-second gun burst/rest, damage and life-cycle exits retained.
remaining: Hellfire guided projectile, ignition, moving-target lead and source flight math are not integrated; existing projectile is still straight vehicle_rocket.

Full original weapon selection/blackwatchVariety gate, separate rapid/Hellfire racks and player ammunition capacities remain to implement. Current 240/8 player stores and MC damage20 are adaptations, not decoded source capacity/damage.
Javelin package property alignment (candidate ignition 0.1, drag 0, vertical drag 0, gravity 28) is not promoted to a fully validated class decoder.
